# Women Investing In _Women's Health_

Portfolia is the most active force in women's health investing, with 2,000+ investors backing **100 investments across 46+ women’s health companies**.

We began investing in women’s health before anyone saw the opportunity. Today our portfolio spans deep science, diagnostics, medical devices, AI-powered platforms, fertility, contraception, menopause, cardiometabolic health, and oncology — the full lifecycle of women’s health.

## Our _Women’s_ Health Portfolio

Since launching the first Women's Health venture fund in 2018, Portfolia has made over 100 investments in Womens Health - more than any other investor globally.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/69557e59b1b80f661cf12e3a_maven_logo.png)

Maven Clinic is a leading virtual women’s and family health platform providing personalized, continuous care across fertility, pregnancy, parenting, pediatrics, and menopause through employers and health plans, improving access, outcomes, and equity with expert clinicians and digital support around the world.

[Visit Maven →](https://www.mavenclinic.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/697156dcb4cfa3f60fcbce72_b68f7798-eef3-47ee-8bfe-17b58a4a188a.png)

Gameto is a biotechnology company focused on improving women’s reproductive health through advanced cell engineering. What makes Gameto unique is its approach to recreating natural ovarian functions to make fertility treatments safer, shorter, and more effective. By developing therapies that span infertility, ovarian health, and menopause, Gameto aims to support women across their entire reproductive lifespan.

[Visit Gameto →](https://www.gametogen.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/6a075952ea6e5e75b960e246_EverlyHealth_Logo-scaled.jpeg)

Everlyhealth helps people take a proactive approach to aging and longevity with at-home health testing. Its tests measure key biomarkers and turn results into a simple, personalized WellScore that shows how a person’s body is aging compared to their actual age. By pairing these insights with clinician-reviewed recommendations, Everly Health helps users make lifestyle changes to improve their long-term health and wellbeing.‎‏‏‎

[Visit Everly Health →](https://www.everlywell.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/6955801c804ce76ffb47201e_mirvie_logo.png)

Mirvie is a biotech transforming pregnancy care with its RNA-based blood test platform that predicts the risk of complications like preeclampsia and preterm birth months before symptoms, enabling personalized, preventive maternal health interventions.

[Visit Mirvie →](https://www.mirvie.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/69703a048cca79d52e9602da_your_choice_logo.png)

Birthcontrol is no longer only a woman's responsibility; men can now help prevent pregnancy. YourChoice is the male counterpart to female birthcontrol. Similar to the female pill, YourChoice is an oral pill taken daily and has a temporary, reversible impact on fertility. The pill is non-hormonal, meaning its implications in the body are known and targeted.

[Visit YourChoice →](https://www.yourchoicetx.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e6939ea_bwell.webp)

b.well is a digital health platform that helps people navigate and personalize their healthcare within an otherwise complex system. It empowers consumers to understand and use their holistic health data so they can advocate for themselves and their loved ones. The platform also supports commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid plans by driving engagement, improving quality, and meeting regulatory requirements.‎

[Visit bwell →](https://www.icanbwell.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e6939fe_madison%2Breed%2Blogo.webp)

Madison Reed is a beauty brand offering salon-quality hair color and care products with cruelty-free formulas, personalized digital tools, and omnichannel services, empowering consumers to achieve professional results at home or in Madison Reed Hair Color Bars nationwide.

[Visit Madison Reed →](https://www.madison-reed.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e6939f3_Untitled%2Bdesign%2B%252838%2529.webp)

Future Family helps people afford fertility treatments like IVF and egg freezing. It stands out by combining fast, flexible financing with personalized guidance from dedicated fertility nurses. This approach reduces financial stress and helps families navigate fertility care with confidence.‏‏‎‎

[Visit Future Family →](https://www.futurefamily.com/about#origin-story)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695ecfa0987966e02b6ad6b4_willow_logo.png)

Willow is a company looking to support those who are breastfeeding. By designing products ranging from pumps to therapy packs for sore breasts, Willow supports the breast feeder in caring for their body. Willow creates empowering products that fit into your daily, active lifestyle.

[Visit Willow →](https://onewillow.com/collections/accessories?utm_source=google&utm_medium=%7Bmedium%7D&utm_campaign=&utm_adgroup=&utm_term=&utm_content=&device=c&placement=&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=22611118947&gbraid=0AAAAADN63Te0iAfAeVqg2Y4y0dknpJutx&gclid=CjwKCAiAu67KBhAkEiwAY0jAleRtoyNrB5auJa-SGIbk0zjmrwBosvcTqscAvkPYrZONbRYV9OB2hBoCWggQAvD_BwE)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/69557e9c804ce76ffb4708a8_mercy_logo.png)

Mercy BioAnalytics is a biotech innovator developing the Mercy Halo™ extracellular vesicle-based liquid biopsy platform to detect cancers like ovarian and lung at earlier, more treatable stages through sensitive, non-invasive blood tests that aim to improve survival and patient outcomes.

[Visit Mercy Bio →](https://mercybio.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/6973db870a582a8f71d7fe74_55a4930a-d459-424c-9e52-cbac4f2ee833.png)

Osteoboost is a wearable belt that helps protect bone health using gentle vibration. It’s designed for people with osteoporosis or low bone density and is worn for just 30 minutes a day during everyday activities. Osteoboost is FDA-cleared and backed by clinical research, offering a simple, drug-free way to support stronger bones.

[Visit Osteoboost →](https://www.osteoboost.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a16_343925ca-c629-4d1d-954a-e1568a9c81fb.webp)

Maude is a retailer of essential sexual wellness products improving intimate experiences. Each of Maude's body-safe products are made to be both easy-to-use and to elevate everyday experience destigmatizing and modernizing sexual health.

[Visit Maude →](https://getmaude.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/69557c8f234d43284d78e6ce_lighthouse_pharma_logo.png)

Lighthouse Pharmaceuticals is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company pioneering precision medicine with novel small-molecule protease inhibitors to treat major unmet needs such as Alzheimer’s disease and other chronic degenerative and inflammatory disorders.

[Visit Lighthouse Pharma →](https://www.lighthousepharma.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a12_Harmony.webp)

Harmony is an infant nutrition company offering a hypoallergenic formula inspired by human milk. It stands out for using clean, gentle ingredients that support digestion, growth, and development. Harmony aims to give families a healthier, more positive feeding experience.

[Visit Harmony →](https://harmonybabynutrition.com/#why)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a1a_104286.png)

Apollo Neuro makes a wearable device that uses gentle, science-backed vibration patterns to train and rebalance the nervous system, helping users reduce stress, improve focus, relax, sleep better, and boost overall resilience without drugs by actively strengthening natural recovery processes.

[Visit Apollo →](https://apolloneuro.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/69617dddb5172393c0dccf1d_frontier_bio_logo.png)

Frontier Bio is a biotechnology company creating lab-grown human tissues to improve medical research and patient care. What makes Frontier Bio unique is its focus on building living human tissues, starting with blood vessels, to replace animal testing and address organ shortages. By using patient-derived cells, Frontier Bio aims to create safer, more effective treatments and move medicine toward a future with on-demand human tissues.

[Visit Frontier Bio →](https://www.frontierbio.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a24_Xfactor-Portfolio-attngrace.webp)

Attn: Grace designs high-performing, sustainably sourced incontinence care products for women, using plant-based, skin-safe materials to provide discreet, comfortable protection from bladder leaks. The female-founded, Certified B Corp aims to improve health, confidence, and quality of life while reducing environmental impact.

[Visit Attn Grace →](https://attngrace.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e6939fa_joylux.webp)

Joylux is a women’s health and femtech company creating high-tech, hormone-free intimate wellness solutions Some items include red-light therapy devices and pH-balanced care products, which improve vaginal health, comfort, and confidence during menopause and midlife, empowering women with science-backed, non-invasive care.

[Visit Joylux →](https://joylux.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695ea4449b59223e28e30da2_proov_logo.png)

At-home testing for women's fertility and hormone levels. Used for proactively regulating hormone levels, Proov offers OB/Gyn services to better support their customers' needs.

[Visit Proov →](https://proovtest.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/69557446229ddc2e3ead6b48_hera_biotech_logo.jpeg)

Hera Biotech is a women’s health diagnostics company developing non-invasive, tissue-based tests that provide faster, accurate detection and staging of conditions like endometriosis and cervical cancer, empowering earlier diagnosis and better outcomes for patients and clinicians.

[Visit Hera Biotech →](https://herabiotech.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/69557cd9ff865b8291b4f2f8_lovu_logo.png)

Lōvu Health is a digital maternal healthcare platform that uses AI-powered monitoring, care navigation, and a curated service marketplace to support women from pre-conception through postpartum, improving outcomes, access, and continuity of care for mothers and babies.

[Visit Lovu →](https://lovu.health/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695580a826b01bf8562d23f7_nalu_bio_logo.png)

Nalu Bio is a biotech unlocking the therapeutic potential of the endocannabinoid system with AI-driven chemistry to develop ultra-pure, non-intoxicating cannabinoid-based ingredients and targeted therapeutics for health and wellness, offering scalable, predictable, and science-backed solutions.

[Visit Nalu Bio →](https://www.nalubio.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695ea8aa843c42c8c55e2491_sana_health_logo.png)

A medi-tech company that developed a wearable audiovisual neuromodulation device that is designed to provide relief from chronic pain and improve well-being through neuromodulation sensors. The product takes the shape of a nighttime sleeping mask. Using the device for just 15 minutes has shown to improve PTSD and pain management!

[Visit Sana Health →](https://www.sana.io/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695eaec57b90ec2f946f4ef6_simple_health_kit_logo.png)

Simple HealthKit provides a fully integrated healthcare platform that combines screenings, real--time insghts and clinical services to ensure proper care. By utilizing AI to proactively assist follow-ups, HealthKit provides members with reliable, accessible healthcare.

[Visit Simple HealthKit →](https://www.simplehealthkit.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e6939e6_aria%2Bcv.webp)

Aria CV is a medical device company developing a novel implantable system to treat pulmonary hypertension, a serious lung-related cardiovascular disease. Their device aims to restore healthy pulmonary artery function, reducing heart workload and improving blood flow and quality of life.

[Visit Aria CV →](https://ariacv.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695d86c9e75f851f9e33df71_89ecfadc-d2c9-4acc-b1d7-63c9b7c30499.png)

Clear Gene is a biotechnology company that helps detect cancer that remains after treatment, known as residual disease. Using genomics and machine learning, the company focuses on improving detection for solid tumors such as breast cancer. Clear Gene’s software and test kits help clinical labs run more samples at lower cost using their existing equipment.

[Visit Clear Gene →](https://cleargene.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/69617e059a38348b38e9d887_FemDx.jpg)

FemDx Medsystems is a medical device company focused on improving how gynecological conditions are diagnosed and treated. The company develops safe, minimally invasive technologies designed to enable earlier and more accurate detection of women’s health conditions. By combining advanced engineering with clinical expertise, FemDx Medsystems helps physicians deliver higher-quality care with reduced patient risk.

[Visit FemDx Medsystems →](https://www.femdxmed.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e6939f2_Health%2BHero.webp)

Health Hero is a platform that helps organizations turn everyday wellness activities into measurable value. What makes it unique is that it treats healthy actions as assets that can be tracked and rewarded across common workplace tools. This helps companies support employee wellbeing while gaining clearer insight into organizational performance.‏‏‎

[Visit Health Hero →](https://www.gohealthhero.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695576663e17a3d7ef0cb431_hey_jane_logo.webp)

Hey Jane is a U.S.-based virtual reproductive and sexual health clinic offering safe, affordable, judgment-free care, including medication abortion, birth control, emergency contraception, and treatment for common infections. It's all delivered through telehealth with licensed clinicians for privacy and convenience.

[Visit Hey Jane →](https://www.heyjane.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/69557b0a7cfd22d5831e6f01_l-nutra_logo.jpeg)

L-Nutra is a science-driven nutri-technology company pioneering plant-based nutrition programs like the ProLon fasting-mimicking diet to support healthy aging, cellular rejuvenation, metabolic health, and chronic disease prevention, bridging research and real-world wellness through clinically validated nutrition solutions.

[Visit LNutra →](https://l-nutra.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a02_nest%2Bcollaborative.webp)

Nest Collaborative is the first and largest virtual lactation support platform connecting families with International Board-Certified Lactation Consultants via on-demand telehealth, providing inclusive, insurance-covered guidance and education throughout the breastfeeding journey to improve maternal and infant feeding outcomes.

[Visit Nest Collaborative →](https://nestcollaborative.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/6955829226b01bf8562d78f7_neuspera_logo.webp)

Neuspera is a medical device company developing next-generation, ultra-miniaturized, wireless neurostimulation implants to treat chronic conditions like urinary urge incontinence and peripheral nerve pain, advancing patient-friendly, minimally invasive therapies through innovative bioelectronic technology.

[Visit Neuspera →](https://neuspera.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a31_New-Nowdx.webp)

NowDx (formerly Aeena) develops and manufactures rapid, easy-to-use over-the-counter and point-of-care diagnostic tests using patented “touch-to-test” technology to deliver accurate health insights in minutes. Their work focuses on expanding accessible, affordable testing outside traditional labs for for conditions like syphilis, pregnancy, and other markers.

[Visit NOWDiagnostics →](https://nowdx.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a03_one%2Bdigital%2Btrust_logo.webp)

OneDigitalTrust is a digital EstateTech platform that simplifies creation and ongoing management of wills, trusts, and estate plans through secure, user-friendly tools integrated into financial institutions and advisors’ offerings. It's affordable, comprehensive legacy planning accessible for individuals and families.

[Visit One Digital Trust →](https://onedigitaltrust.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a23_oralucent.webp)

Developer of a light-emitting toothbrush designed to brush away dental problems with blue light technology. The company's toothbrush kills bacteria that cause gum disease, plaque, gingivitis and bad breath as well as enhances teeth whitening, enabling users to improve their dental health and whiten their teeth.

[Visit Oralucent →](https://oralucent.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a3f_siren-logo.webp)

Siren Socks helps reduce the risk of ulcers through early detection of potential injuries. Siren socks measure foot temperature to help reduce your risk of ulcers; higher temperatures tend to indicate inflammation and therefore a sign of injury.

[Visit Siren →](https://www.siren.care/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695eb0640cc9498754777908_toilabs_logo.png)

Toi Labs mission is to improve health and wellness in your home; the company pioneered the first toilet seat that can mointor health realted clues in human excrement. After analyzing said excreta, Toi Labs can identify abnormalities and create actionable insights to track and optimize gut health.

[Visit Toi Labs →](https://trueloo.online/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695ecd58bc48029f057f4443_wellth_logo.png)

Wellth can be used as a supplementary application to incentivize and motivate individuals on care plans to engage with curative behaviors. Wellth helps individuals struggling to manage their chronic conditions create healthy habits by utilizing behavioral economics to develop personalized care and medication plans that are as cost-effective as possible. The app helps motivate those struggling to take care of themselves.

[Visit Wellth →](https://www.wellthapp.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695ed48906b69d945470474b_xk_logo.png)

Xandar Kardian centers health for both people and buildings. XK uses radars to redefine how human and building health are monitored, analyzed, and improved. Radars are used for a variety of needs, from continuous vital monitoring to precise data and people counting. The radar can be used to support firms manage thir buildings and helps support health care for those on care plans.

[Visit Xandar Kardian →](https://xkcorp.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/695ed4f836ee97dcba2710f4_xcure_logo.png)

xCure's AI-powered platform receives medical records, applies validated methods to seek out useful information, and delivers the information to internal tools and workflows. xCures serves as a middleman in digitized healthcare. By processing records and finding pertinent information, the platform collaborates with doctors to provide optimized, quality care.

[Visit xCures →](https://xcures.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a2c_LOGOINHERENT.webp)

Inherent Biosciences is a biotechnology company pioneering epigenetic diagnostics and AI-enabled tools to improve reproductive health, starting with advanced sperm quality testing that goes beyond traditional semen analysis to guide more personalized fertility care and raise standards of diagnosis and treatment.

[Visit Inherent Biosciences →](https://www.inherentbio.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693588/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e693a01_madorra.webp)

Madorra is a women’s health medtech company developing the first non-hormonal, non-invasive home-use medical device to treat vaginal dryness and vulvovaginal atrophy, empowering post-menopausal women and breast cancer survivors with a safer alternative to traditional therapies.

[Visit Madorra →](https://www.madorra.com/)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e69357f/6966b6dc2c9759cbbefc0aec_pa-company-img2.avif)

## Why Women’s Health

Many of us already know this to be true:

Women's Health has been historically overlooked, underfunded, and misunderstood. Our lives, our families, and our futures have been shaped by a lack of investment in solutions designed for us. When capital flows into Women's Health, outcomes improve not just for women today, but for our daughters and grandchildren. Women's Health is also a $600B+ global market with enormous unmet need.

Investing early and thoughtfully in markets like this can drive real change and build meaningful wealth. At Portfolia, we believe you shouldn't have to choose between impact and returns. You deserve both.

## We Built a _Different Model_ On Purpose

Portfolia is not a traditional venture capital firm. We built Portfolia to reflect how women actually make decisions: collaboratively, thoughtfully, and with both heart and head.\`

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e69357f/696005b26a4e5fe6a2e98d81_Vector.svg)

### A Community of Investors

More than 2,000 women and allies invest together through Portfolia, bringing lived experience, insight, and networks no institutional fund can replicate.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e69357f/696005b2d597b23714e4a968_Vector-1.svg)

### Education Is Built In

You don’t need a background in venture capital to invest with us. Portfolia is designed to be accessible, transparent, and educational.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e69357f/696005b2a09e326c25cbe714_Vector-2.svg)

### A Seat at the Table

Investors can join live pitch calls, hear directly from founders, and watch fund partners evaluate opportunities in real time.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e69357f/696005b2cbab1c0c5e49d459_Vector-3.svg)

### Diversification by Design

Exposure across stages, subsectors, and risk profiles within Women’s Health.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e69357f/696005b2ad60820a1aab9211_Vector-4.svg)

### Professional Fund Leadership

Our funds are led by experienced partners with deep domain expertise and strong track records.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d58a6f798fa3fc2e69357f/6960075e4821c0b3030a27a4_pa-company-img3.avif)

## More Than a Fund. A Community.

When you invest with Portfolia, you're not just deploying capital. You're joining a community of women who believe our experiences matter, our health deserves investment, and our money can shape the future.

Together, we are changing outcomes for women—and building returns along the way
